content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to change the background color in the Analog Value box so that only the numeric value is visible? See attached image.

Within [product_name] Web Editor itself, changing the background color for an analog value is not possible. If you are skilled in HTML5, you may be able to achieve this. Otherwise, it can't be done directly.
Okay, I will look into that, but I don’t see how to do it. Thanks for confirming that it’s at least possible.
Has there been any progress or news about this feature?
No, there have not been any changes.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about customizing the background color of an Analog Value display in [product_name] Web Editor, aiming to show only the numeric value. Community members clarified that this option is not natively available, and it would require advanced HTML5 knowledge. The discussion reveals a feature limitation and highlights the gap between available customization tools and user requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward customization options within the product interface, like changing the background of the Analog Value box, and prefer not to rely on complex coding skills for UI adjustments.
